a: Mitosis phases include prophase, metaphase, anaphase, telophase.
Chromosomes are DNA structures that carry genes.
A gene is a unit of heredity that influences traits.
Alleles are different versions of a gene.
Phenotype is the observable traits of an organism.
Genotype is the genetic makeup of an organism.
Natural selection favors traits that improve reproductive success.
Food chains show energy flow from producers to consumers.
Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions.
